models.name: H-16
models.summary: 16mm camera taking 100ft (30m) and 50ft (15m) daylight loading spools, with automatic threading and loop forming, a constant-speed spring motor, and a rotating turret accommodating three interchangeable C-mount lenses.

models.name: H-16 Supreme
models.summary: 16mm camera with 100ft (30m) and 50ft (15m) daylight loading spool capacity.

models.name: H-16 S
models.summary: Non-reflex, turret-style 16mm camera.

models.name: H-16 M
models.summary: Accommodates a single interchangeable C-mount lens; variable speeds of 8, 16, 24, 32 and 64 frames per second.

models.name: H-16 M-4
models.summary: Began production in 1965.

models.name: H-16 M-5
models.summary: Began production in 1967.

models.name: H-16 Reflex
models.summary: Rotating turret with three interchangeable RX-type C-mount lenses; reflex viewing through a semi-reflecting prism with groundglass focusing.

models.name: H-16 REX
models.summary: Introduced in 1959.

models.name: H-16 REX-5
models.summary: Began production in 1966; introduced in 1967.

models.name: H-8
models.summary: Double 8mm model of the H camera line, introduced 1938.

models.name: H-8 REX
models.summary: The first 8mm reflex camera manufactured by Bolex.

models.name: L-8 (early model)
models.summary: Double 8mm camera introduced in 1942.

models.name: B-8
models.summary: Double 8mm camera introduced in 1953.

models.name: B-8L
models.summary: First in the series of "Compumatic" cameras, providing an easy method for determining proper exposure using a photo-electric selenium cell and galvanometer needle.

models.name: C-8
models.summary: Double 8mm camera introduced in 1954.

models.name: 150 Super
models.summary: The first Bolex Super 8 model. Unconventional design with a built-in lens, bright reflex viewfinder, and a film chamber located on top of the camera body.

models.name: 155 Macrozoom
models.summary: Improved on the 150 Super. The Macrozoom lens focuses as close as one inch; the viewing system features a coincident-image rangefinder.

models.name: 160 Macrozoom
models.summary: Introduced in 1970, the latest model in the Macrozoom series.

models.name: 7.5 Macrozoom
models.summary: Introduced in 1969 as a lower-priced option to the 155/160 series.

models.name: S1 Automatic
models.summary: Assigned its own unique serial number range by Paillard in 1963 alongside the P-series and K-series cameras.
